reviews.title: False Advertisement / No Support
reviews.text:
I have unfortunately had a very disappointing experience with SellRaze.

The app has been plagued by constant bugs, syncing issues, and features that simply do not work as advertised. For a service that charges customers a subscription fee, I expected a much more reliable product and a higher level of support when problems arise.

What has been most frustrating is the lack of meaningful assistance from the development and support team. When customers are paying for a service, especially one that is supposed to help manage listings across multiple marketplaces, reliability and responsive support should be a priority.

Several of the features advertised as part of the service have either not worked properly or have been extremely inconsistent in my experience. These issues defeat the entire purpose of using a cross-listing platform in the first place.

If I could go back, I would not have downloaded SellRaze or paid for the subscription. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this app to other resellers. Save yourself the frustration and look elsewhere for a more reliable cross-listing solution.

reviews.title: Very disappointing experience.
reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience. I paid for the Elite plan because the app clearly advertised “Unlimited Listings,” but after subscribing, my account showed a 300-listing limit. When I contacted support, I received conflicting answers from different representatives about what the Elite plan actually includes.

I was also initially told that I could bulk cross-list my existing eBay listings to Facebook Marketplace, only to later be told that bulk cross-listing existing listings is not available and that I have to open and edit each listing individually. This defeats one of the main reasons I subscribed in the first place, especially as a reseller with hundreds of active listings.

I contacted support multiple times asking for clarification, but after initially responding, they stopped providing a clear answer. I was told my case would be escalated and marked as a priority, yet I still have not received a proper resolution.

The advertising, the information inside the app, and the answers from customer support have been inconsistent. I purchased the subscription based on features that appeared to be included, only to find out afterward that the actual limitations were different. I ended up requesting a refund through Apple.

I would not recommend paying for this app until they clearly communicate their plan limits and features and improve their customer support.

I still don’t know if I’ll get back to the original setting. Once you integrate your eBay, you can no longer offer free shipping, have the customer pay for only a partial amount. You can’t pick how you want to ship the item (through usps,ups or FedEx.) I only use this app to scan items to see a - round about price for the item. The pricing this app gives can also change daily. I know it bases it off current sales price and past sales. But can still price it at a 50% difference from experience. The integration isn’t good especially since all the apps have different inputs when listing an item. I don’t like it. I’m sure theres another app to help you find current pricing,  if not I’ll build one. 

When trying to integrate your apps, this app should warn you. 
“YOUR EBAY POLICIES WILL COMPLETELY CHANGE AND NOT FOR THE BETTER.”

reviews.title: You have BEEN WARNED
reviews.text:
I subscribed to SellRaze specifically for its advertised core feature: automatically delisting items across marketplaces once an item sells. Unfortunately, this feature does not work reliably, particularly with Mercari.

I have experienced multiple confirmed sales where the item remained active and available for purchase across platforms inside SellRaze, creating a serious risk of overselling, forced cancellations, account defects, and lost revenue. This defeats the primary reason for paying for the service.

I reported the issue multiple times and provided clear screenshots showing:
	•	A confirmed Mercari sale
	•	The same item still active in SellRaze
	•	No automatic deletion or delisting occurring

Support has acknowledged the issue and escalated it internally, but there is no fix, no ETA, and no reliable workaround. The problem continues to repeat.

This is not a minor bug — it is a failure of a core paid function. Until this is resolved, sellers are forced to manually monitor and delete listings, which makes the subscription unjustifiable.

I cannot recommend this app to serious resellers until the automatic delisting functionality works as advertised.
